explain.bmi: Relates your weight to your height.
explain.waist: Estimates the fat accumulated around the abdomen.
explain.hba1c: Reflects your average blood sugar over the last 3 months.
explain.triglycerides: Fats in the blood; they rise with sugar, alcohol and inactivity.
explain.blood_pressure: The force of blood against your arteries; the higher of the two readings counts.

fields.walkAfterMealsText: Walk 10 minutes after the main meals
fields.breakSittingText: Stand up and move 2–3 minutes every 30–60 minutes sitting

progression.aerobic_build: Add 5 minutes per session every 1–2 weeks if well tolerated, up to 30 minutes.
progression.aerobic_150: Progress to at least 150 minutes per week of moderate activity.
progression.aerobic_maintain: Maintain the volume and add 1–2 short higher-intensity intervals if there are no contraindications.
progression.strength_load: When all reps feel easy (effort below 5), add load or one more set.
progression.steps_build: Increase about 1,000 steps per day each week until the target.

safety.medical_clearance: Requires medical assessment before increasing intensity.
safety.low_impact: Prefer low-impact activities (bike, water, flat walking) and avoid jumps.
safety.pain_rule: Pain during exercise should not exceed 3/10 nor last more than 24 h; if it does, reduce the load and tell your physiotherapist.
safety.stop_symptoms: Stop and seek care if you feel chest pain, unusual shortness of breath, dizziness or palpitations.

rationale.medical_clearance: Cardiovascular history, very high blood pressure or clinical alerts: conservative intensity.
rationale.low_impact: BMI ≥ 35, pain ≥ 5/10 or musculoskeletal limitations: low-impact activities.
rationale.activity_unknown: Weekly physical activity not recorded: starts at an introductory level.
rationale.start_gradually: Low activity, low walking capacity or high pain: short sessions with gradual progression.
rationale.below_150: Below 150 min/week of activity: plan to reach the recommended minimum.
rationale.active: Already reaches 150 min/week: maintenance with more strength work.
rationale.weak_lower_limbs: Low sit-to-stand or reduced gait speed: extra lower-limb strength work.
rationale.weak_grip: Low grip strength: grip exercises and upper-limb strength.
rationale.balance_priority: Age ≥ 65 or weak lower limbs: balance work 3 days a week.
rationale.sitting: Six or more hours sitting per day: active breaks every 30–60 minutes.

nutrition.error: The action could not be completed.

plate.help: Plate method: half vegetables, a quarter protein and a quarter whole grains or tubers.

plan.copied: New draft created from the plan

fields.noEnergy: Calories are not estimated because weight, height, age or sex are missing. Follow the food guidance below.
fields.protein_each_meal: Include a protein source in every meal
fields.regular_schedule: Regular meal times, without skipping meals
fields.avoidHelp: Active allergies and intolerances from the record are added automatically. Press Enter to add more.

rationale.weight_loss: BMI or waist above target: moderate calorie deficit to reduce weight and abdominal fat.
rationale.maintenance: BMI and waist within target: energy to maintain weight.
rationale.missing_anthropometry: Weight, height, age or sex missing: calories were not estimated.
rationale.renal_review: Elevated creatinine: protein kept at 0.8 g/kg pending medical/renal review.
rationale.glycemic: Glucose, HbA1c or history compatible with altered glucose: fewer and better-quality carbohydrates, spread through the day.
rationale.triglycerides: High triglycerides: limit sugars and alcohol.
rationale.lipids: Altered lipid profile or cardiovascular history: less saturated fat, more fish, fibre and unsaturated fats.
rationale.blood_pressure: Blood pressure above target or hypertension: lower sodium.
rationale.uric_acid: High uric acid: limit fructose drinks, organ meats and alcohol.
rationale.liver: Fatty liver or high liver enzymes: avoid alcohol and sugary drinks.
rationale.allergies: Allergies or intolerances recorded: excluded foods are listed.

limit.organ_meats: Organ meats and seafood in excess

targets.fruit_veg_5: 5 servings of fruit and vegetables a day
targets.ultraprocessed_down: Ultra-processed foods at most 3 times a week
targets.weight_5pct: Lose 5% of body weight in 3–6 months
targets.water_daily: Drink the recommended water every day

safety.professional_review: Targets are adjusted by your professional at each follow-up.
safety.no_extreme_diets: Avoid very low-calorie or extreme diets.
safety.diabetes_meds: If you take medication for diabetes, changes in carbohydrates may cause low glucose: monitor and consult.
safety.renal_review: Kidney function to be reviewed before increasing protein.
safety.allergy_check: Check labels: allergens can be hidden in processed foods.
safety.b12_review: Vegan diet: vitamin B12 supplementation to be reviewed.
